First find the volume of the sandbox: 2 feet * 4 feet * 5 feet = 40 cubic feet
Then find the weight of the sand by multiplying the volume by the weight per cubic foot: 40 cubic feet * 3 pounds/cubic foot = 120 pounds
Then divide the weight of the sand by the weight the bucket can hold to find the number of trips he needs to make: 120 pounds / 2 pounds/trip = 60 trips
Then divide the number of trips by 4 to find how many times he drinks water: 60 trips / 4 trips = 15 times
Then multiply the number of times he drinks water by the amount of water he drinks to find the total amount of water he drinks: 15 times * 3 ounces/time = 45 ounces
Then divide the total amount of water he drinks by the amount of water in a bottle to find how many bottles he needs to buy: 45 ounces / 15 ounces/bottle = 3 bottles
Then multiply the number of bottles by the cost per bottle to find the total cost: 3 bottles * $2/bottle = $6
Then subtract the total cost of the water from the amount of money Tony has to find the change he will have: $10 - $6 = $4
